definitions: Small carnivorous mammals native to Africa, Asia, and southern Europe, known for their agility and ability to kill venomous snakes.
Any of various slender, ferretlike carnivores of the family Herpestidae, native to Africa and Eurasia, many species of which are noted for their ability to kill venomous snakes.
examples: The mongooses were quick to dart into the undergrowth.
Several species of mongooses are found in India.
Mongooses are known for their snake-fighting abilities.
